facts.claim: Listed for Web Summit Lisbon 2026 (LIS26) on its own appearance page: Raras Health, Brazil, Healthtech & wellness, a startup in the Growth track.
Its Web Summit pitch says "Our AI assistant, Rara, already talks to 300+ families a week on WhatsApp", and uses AI and genomics for diagnosis.

The company's own site, its home page (read 7 November 2026, 03:25 UTC): its website; and a description of what the company does: rare disease diagnosis and care in Brazil, with a clinical team and AI: Raras Genomics, Raras Care, Raras Intelligence. It does not state the 300 million figure.
